description: The failure detector's status, and since when it has been so: `since` is `null` exactly while the status is `unchecked`. Evidence that the detector is scoring the print comes before its health check.

oneOf.description: The detector is scoring the print, from `since` on, and no failure alert of its own has arrived for it.

probe_failure.description: What the detector's health check answered, when it is failing while the detector scores the print.

oneOf.description: The detector is scoring the print, from `since` on, and a failure alert of its own has arrived for it.

probe_failure.description: What the detector's health check answered, when it is failing while the detector scores the print.

oneOf.description: No evidence that the detector is scoring the print, and it answered its health check, from `since` on: available, with no scores yet.

scoring_unread.description: Why the detector's scoring of the print is not being read, when it is not: no Obico API is configured, no Obico printer is known yet, or the last read failed.

oneOf.description: No evidence that the detector is scoring the print, and it did not answer its health check, from `since` on.

scoring_unread.description: Why the detector's scoring of the print is not being read, when it is not: no Obico API is configured, no Obico printer is known yet, or the last read failed.

oneOf.description: No evidence of any kind: no detector health address is configured, or no check has been made yet, and nothing shows the detector scoring.

scoring_unread.description: Why the detector's scoring of the print is not being read, when it is not: no Obico API is configured, no Obico printer is known yet, or the last read failed.

since.description: Nothing: an unchecked detector has no instant it became so.
